# RotateTexture <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [Blitz3D](Blitz3D) · [Textures](Blitz3D-Textures)

</div>


```blitzbasic
RotateTexture:Void texture:Int32, angle:Float32
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `texture` | In | Int32 | required | The texture to turn. |
| `angle` | In | Float32 | required | Angle in degrees. |

## Description

Turns the texture coordinates by an absolute angle in degrees. Meant for swirling effects such as smoke.
The rotation turns the coordinates around their origin (the corner of the picture) before ScaleTexture and PositionTexture are applied, as in the original.
